name: 香甜柴火饭感多功能电饭煲款

styleLock.backgroundSystem: seamless white #FFFFFF for packshot and trust shots, warm cream #F6EFE3 for infographic and CTA screens, light wood tabletop with a softly blurred warm kitchen for scene shots; clean depth, no busy textures
styleLock.lightingSystem: bright soft studio lighting with a front-left key, soft fill, soft contact shadows, controlled warm highlights on metal surfaces; scene shots may use warm window light around 5000K with declared direction
styleLock.surfaceSystem: matte warm-cream board #F6EFE3 for infographics, light oak-toned wood countertop #D9C4A5 for scenes, seamless white for packshots
styleLock.typography: modern geometric sans-serif headline type in #33383D on light panels, thin-line feature labels in the warm-orange accent #E8813A; champagne-gold metal #C8A468 kept as the body finish accent
styleLock.iconSystem: thin-line icons and rounded rectangular label chips in a single accent color
styleLock.presentationRules: stable centered product presentation, consistent product scale across the set, straight lines rendered true with no warping, metal finish shown with controlled highlights, every screen composed as one complete balanced layout
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent warm premium kitchen appliance visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of clean white #FFFFFF, warm cream #F6EFE3, charcoal text #33383D, warm-orange action accent #E8813A and a champagne-gold metal body accent #C8A468; warm tone throughout; bright soft studio lighting with a front-left key, soft fill, soft contact shadows and controlled warm highlights on metal; modern geometric sans-serif headline type in charcoal #33383D with thin-line feature labels in the warm-orange accent #E8813A; consistent thin-line icons and rounded rectangular label chips in a single accent color; every screen composed as one complete balanced layout with natural breathing margins; stable centered product presentation and scale with true straight lines; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no fake brand marks.
